import re
p='store/mod.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("mod hosted;\nmod read;","mod hosted;\nmod human;\nmod read;")
s=s.replace("pub use hosted::HostedRun;","pub use hosted::HostedRun;\npub use human::{HumanActionRow, RecordedAction};")
old_start=s.index("    pub fn insert_events(&mut self, events: &[Event]) -> Result<usize, StoreError> {")
old_end=s.index("    /// Deletes the events read from the lines")
body=s[old_start:old_end]
new_pub="""    pub fn insert_events(&mut self, events: &[Event]) -> Result<usize, StoreError> {
        let tx = self.conn.transaction()?;
        let added = insert_events_in(&tx, events)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(added)
    }

"""
# build the free function from the body
inner=body.split("let tx = self.conn.transaction()?;\n",1)[1]
inner=inner.replace("        tx.commit()?;\n        Ok(added)\n    }\n\n","")
# dedent by 4
lines=inner.split("\n")
ded="\n".join(l[4:] if l.startswith("    ") else l for l in lines)
func="fn insert_events_in(tx: &rusqlite::Transaction<'_>, events: &[Event]) -> Result<usize, StoreError> {\n    let mut added = 0;\n"+ded.rstrip()+"\n    Ok(added)\n}\n\n"
s=s[:old_start]+new_pub+s[old_end:]
s=s.replace("fn to_i64(value: u64) -> i64 {", func+"fn to_i64(value: u64) -> i64 {")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
